items.title: Second quarter 2026 production results
facts: Q2 global iron ore production was 87.1 Mt on a 100% basis.
Q2 global iron ore sales were 88.8 Mt, up 5% year over year.
Q2 Pilbara iron ore sales were 85.3 Mt, up 7% year over year.

items.title: Operational review for the year ended 30 June 2026
facts: BHP reported record iron ore production for the financial year.
The release described stronger realised iron ore prices year over year.

items.title: Production and sales in 1Q26
facts: Q1 iron ore production was 69.7 Mt, up 3% year over year.
Q1 iron ore sales were 68.7 Mt, up 4% year over year.
Average realised iron ore fines price was US$95.8/t.

items.title: Amendments to the iron ore futures contract and business rules
facts: The amended rules apply to I2704 and later contracts.
The source should be monitored when interpreting contract continuity across the change.
